title: Discord Notification
blurb: The Discord message notification — the soft double-knock that means someone needs you, or far more likely, that someone has posted a meme at two in the morning. Discord's sound design is deliberately gentle compared to phone alerts, because the app assumes you'll hear it hundreds of times a day and shouldn't come to hate it. That familiarity is exactly what makes it useful here: play it in any room containing gamers and watch several people reflexively check a second monitor. Essential for edits about group chats, servers, and being perceived.
